create_ipndm_scheduler: create an IPNDMScheduler instance with 1000 training timesteps for diffusion model inference
set_timesteps_for_inference: set discrete timesteps on the IPNDMScheduler for a given number of inference steps
step_denoising_sample: perform one denoising step using the IPNDMScheduler multistep method to predict the previous sample
set_begin_index: set the begin index on the IPNDMScheduler before running inference from a pipeline
scale_model_input: scale the denoising model input tensor using the IPNDMScheduler scale_model_input method
